## Supported behavior and limits

The router adds evidence advice while preserving original task/question/scope/input identity, AND dependencies, budget, leases, typed failures and journal history. Initial applicable D5 support selects an **independent source-review reservation** instead of repeating initial discovery. The result remains **claimed, awaiting review**. Existing typed-failure and expiry follow-up remain original planner behavior.

The RN3 note remains fixed to d=2, L=24, r=1/20, b=6/5, k=1/6 and axial pins. It does not discharge the uniform normalizer task. The separate v22 analytic uniform-normalizer argument exists at its source scope; registering that additional route is outside this one-route release. Invalid/stale evidence cannot install authority or suppress legitimate discovery.
